_note: Covered regions. expected_trails is a collapse tripwire, self-baselined: the count this build measured on 13 Nov 2026; the build fails if a region comes in under 50% of it. It is not an independent OSM figure. classics: each name must be found in the region's names.json with a length in len_m (metres), be ranked first by the app's own name search, and have a stored gain within max_err_pct (default 15) of published_ft (one-way headline gain in feet, source given). stored_len_m: range for the stored (stitched) length when it differs from names.json. v1: also publish the frozen old-format copy at trails/ (Washington only).

classics.name: Dog Mountain Trails
classics.note: Known: the stitched chain is 6.89 mi, the published loop length, but it has an extra 1,128 ft up-and-down leg before the river-level trailhead; the trailhead-to-summit part alone is 2,621 ft (-6.4% against published). Not DEM noise: gain changes under 1% from 2 m to 20 m of smoothing. Tolerance widened only to catch regressions.

classics.name: Eagle Creek Trail
classics.note: Trailhead to Wahtum Lake: 1,500 ft over the first 7 miles plus 2,250 ft over the next 5, per that guide (sources vary).

classics.name: Misery Ridge
classics.note: Loop figure (5.09 mi, 700 ft); other guides give 910 to 1,100 ft for the ridge climb.
